summary: Crash when setting LodestonePos of compass to something other than NBT compound
description: The bug The game crashes when changing or creating a compass item with a LodestonePos having a value other than an NBT compound tag. [^(20w17a) crash-2020-04-23_21.44.55-server.txt] Description: Ticking player java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la at bhr.a(SourceFile:144) at bje.a(SourceFile:454) at bcw.j(SourceFile:290) at bcx.l(SourceFile:575) at anz.h(SourceFile:2217) at bcx.h(SourceFile:274) at ys.i(SourceFile:411) at zj.b(SourceFile:199) at ma.a(SourceFile:234) at zi.c(SourceFile:171) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:839) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:766) at enn.a(SourceFile:89) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.run(SourceFile:625) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745) How to reproduce Do this in a test world /give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"} The game freezes and you will see in the log file that it has crashed
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Open the chat window and enter the command `/give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}`.
4. Press Enter to execute the command.
5. Wait for the game to process the command.
6. Observe that the game crashes and freezes, and check the log file for the crash report.
Observed Behavior:
When attempting to create or modify a compass item in Minecraft with an invalid `LodestonePos` value (specifically, a value that is not formatted as a valid NBT compound), the game crashes. This occurs due to a `ClassCastException` that arises when the game tries to interpret the erroneous string as a valid NBT compound. The error message indicates that the game is unable to cast the incorrect value to the expected NBT type, leading to a failure in processing the player's tick event.

To reproduce this crash, execute the command `/give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}` in a test world. Upon execution, the game freezes, and the error log will contain a stack trace detailing the crash. The log indicates that the issue originates from the `bhr.a` method, which is responsible for handling the Lodestone properties of the compass during player updates. This crash highlights the need for proper validation of NBT data types when setting item properties, specifically for the `LodestonePos` tag on compasses.
Expected Behavior: When setting the LodestonePos of a compass, the game should accept valid NBT compound tags without crashing. If an invalid value is provided, such as a string that is not an NBT compound, the game should display an error message indicating the invalid input, allowing players to correct their command without causing a crash. This behavior should ensure a smooth user experience and maintain game stability.
